record_verbatim.rationale: The first half of this requirement restates the enforcement the safety goal needs. The second half is new at system level and is the boundary the stakeholder need FB2-SYS-NED-000002 depends on: the difference between a degraded item that stays usable and an item that disconnects on the first channel disagreement. Neither the existing SOA software requirement nor the plausibility requirement states that boundary, because in both cases the boundary is a question about the integrated item's behaviour rather than about one module's algorithm. The corpus records no numerical value for the degraded-to-fault boundary and this requirement deliberately does not invent one; it requires the boundary to exist and to be declared, which is what makes its absence visible.

record_verbatim.statement: The item shall compare every monitored cell voltage against the configured maximum and minimum limits, shall require two consecutive violations within 100 ms before classifying a violation, and shall move to its degraded mode rather than to the safe state when a measurement channel's disagreement is explainable by a degradation within the declared plausibility envelope, escalating to the safe state only when the degradation removes the reference the item needs.
record_verbatim.title: SYR: the item shall enforce the configured safe operating area, and shall distinguish a recoverable measurement degradation from a limit violation
